title: Guest saw no UFO trace among Stony Brook physicists
place_text: Stony Brook University, Yang Institute for Theoretical Physics

tellings.quote: interacted heavily with basically all of the leading professors of theoretical physics at Stonybrook at the time, 2004 to 2008 in the Yang Institute for Theoretical Physics and the math department. I was president of the math club for like a couple of years. So, I I spoke to the various prominent mathematicians. I never came across any hint or trace of any sort of interest in um UFOs or

plain: A researcher named Maaneli Derakhshani says that from 2004 to 2008, as a student at Stony Brook University in New York, he spent a lot of time with the leading theoretical physicists at its Yang Institute for Theoretical Physics and with the math department, where he ran the math club. He says he never saw any hint that any of them were interested in UFOs, which he offers against the idea that the place was quietly tied to such research.
